name: Dimmer
summary: A wall dimmer you tap to switch and drag to dim, lighting a swaying pendant lamp over a side table
about: A switch and a slider in one paddle on a wall plate, under a pendant lamp in a cosy room. A tap dips the paddle, the filament glows deep orange and flickers, then the light springs up past its level and settles while a light cone, a pool on the table and drifting dust motes fade in. Dragging the paddle dims it and lower levels turn warmer, and switching off leaves a short orange afterglow on the filament.
how: Tap the paddle (or Tab to it and press Space) to switch the light on or off.
Drag the paddle up or down, or press the up and down arrow keys on it, to dim.
Use the brightness slider for fine control; moving it turns the light on.
Pick Read, Relax or Night to glide to a ready-made scene.
